question: How long would the selected exact CPU nearest-neighbor searches inside printed-position ISET ADASYN take at the full frozen cardinalities?
boundary: The estimate is a linear extrapolation from the same exact CPU neighbor implementation on one Panther node.
It excludes synthetic-row generation, memory allocation, serialization, and any retries.
It is not an estimate of the authors' runtime because their library, search implementation, hardware, subsampling, and preprocessing boundary are not reported.
Exact GPU search or approximate-neighbor search could be materially faster.
